summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature in the repository, without running any tests, mypy, or repository code. Changes: rich/segment.py adds ControlType.SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in ControlCode. rich/control.py adds the format entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and the Control.title classmethod. rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title beside show_cursor and set_alt_screen, gated only on is_terminal, with the spec's docstring caveats. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one elif branch that calls term.set_title(title) for title controls. CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added heading with one bullet linking PR 2200. Tests were added to existing modules: test_control.py (Control.title segment and control list), test_console.py (set_window_title output on forced terminal, byte check skipped on legacy Windows, return value asserted always), and test_windows_renderer.py (Windows-only set_title call with a mocked wrapper). Nothing was committed. Verification is by reading only; tests have not been executed.
